Description: Mock grant for Ontario businesses entering new markets and expanding distribution.
Process: Review eligibility, contact the Ontario Growth Agency intake team, prepare the growth plan and budget, submit the application, and respond to review questions.
Eligibility: Ontario businesses with an operating model and a documented market expansion plan.
Eligible Uses: Market research, marketing, hiring, equipment, and implementation costs.
Target Company Types: Small and medium-sized Ontario businesses pursuing measurable market growth.
Required Evidence: Business profile, financial information, growth plan, budget, and milestones.

Description: Mock loan for Atlantic businesses funding working capital, equipment, and expansion.
Process: Start with an eligibility and borrowing conversation with the Atlantic Canada Opportunities Agency, prepare financial statements and a cash flow forecast, submit the financing package, and respond to underwriting questions.
Eligibility: Atlantic Canadian businesses with a viable plan and ability to repay financing.
Eligible Uses: Working capital, equipment, inventory, hiring, marketing, and expansion.
Target Company Types: Established Atlantic Canadian businesses with a clear growth plan.
Required Evidence: Financial statements, cash flow forecast, ownership details, business plan, and budget.

Description: Mock clean technology grant supporting energy efficiency, electrification, and implementation.
Process: Confirm project fit with the program contact, prepare a technical assessment and vendor quotes, submit the project plan and outcomes, and complete the program review.
Eligibility: Canadian businesses with a measurable clean technology adoption project.
Eligible Uses: Energy equipment, implementation, engineering support, and staff training.
Target Company Types: Canadian businesses with an operating site and a documented environmental opportunity.
Required Evidence: Technical assessment, project plan, vendor quotes, financial information, and outcomes.
